# Adding compute machines to bare metal {#adding-bare-metal-compute-user-infra}

To scale your OpenShift Container Platform cluster on bare-metal or platform-agnostic infrastructure, you can add more compute machines. Create {{ op_system }} machines, then approve their certificate signing requests.
